hook.name: ProofLaunchHook
hook.description: Launch hook for token launches with phase-gated trading (Execution phase is vault-only, Public phase is open), ETH-denominated buy/sell taxes that decay linearly from configurable start rates (capped at 10% buy / 15% sell) to resting rates (capped at 2.5%/2.5%), a cumulative max-wallet buy cap that ramps up during early public trading, and liquidity gating that blocks all third-party LP operations.
